About the founder

SADIXOV ILHAM CAVID OĞLU

Founder of FerstacLabs technical brand / Independent technical partner for ERP and custom software projects

Ilham joins projects when a client’s activity cannot be fully managed with standard software and a custom solution is required.

He analyzes company requirements, prepares technical tasks and organizes ERP and custom software development together with programming teams.

He oversees the process from planning to testing, implementation and final delivery.

His practical experience covers software development, system modernization, database design and business process digitalization.

Through work with Technosec LTD in the United Kingdom, he participated in enterprise-level software development and support processes for Gain Theory.

Under the FerstacLabs technical brand, he focuses on business software, ERP-oriented custom solutions, AI automation and digital products for construction management.
